statement: Satisfying the algebraic encoding is insufficient for acceptance as a decomposition; decoded summands must lift and sum to the target.
scope: The declared Semaev/chained systems and x-coordinate models.
assumptions: Original finite-field equations and explicit curve-lift/sum checks.
not_implied: A lift filter is sufficient to prove every algebraic root is a valid point decomposition.
An algebraic SAT witness alone solves the curve problem.
lesson: Preserve equation validity and point validity as distinct checks.
next_discriminating_test: Retain an algebraic-only negative canary and require actual point-sum certificates on every returned model.
revisit_when: Retain an algebraic-only negative canary and require actual point-sum certificates on every returned model.
